items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I saw the 100 great jazz records. There was a picture of Kind of Blue session by Don Hunstein.

ctx.x: And you’re trying to get high fidelity.

But when I think about it, it’s like, everything was a game to me. But, at the same time, I would listen to these recordings, not knowing about a recording console, not knowing about high-end microphones, not knowing about reverb, not knowing about concert halls or churches. I didn’t know anything at all, other than the fact that their record sounded better than what I was doing. So I would start experimenting with distances. We’d do it in the living room. It just didn’t sound right. So we moved to the bathroom.…
Branford found RCA – he discovered RCA studios. That was the biggest room in New York at the time. That’s where a lot of the recordings began.
